records.title: Withdrawal queues at the Bank of England's vault stretch from days to four-to-eight weeks as roughly 393 tonnes flee London for Comex New York on tariff fears.
records.text: Withdrawal queues at the Bank of England's vault stretch from days to four-to-eight weeks as roughly 393 tonnes flee London for Comex New York on tariff fears. A physical run on the world's second-largest gold vault — met with explanations, not policy. The metal moved west before the tariffs even landed.
kv: The Gold Runs From London to New York
